## PR 482

**Image-to-video engine with provider adapter and best-of-2 — part 1 (V1 C8.6 item 2)**

**বাংলায়:** স্টুডিও › ভিডিও: একটা পণ্যের লাইভ ছবি থেকে ছোট ক্লিপের দাম আগে দেখে, তারপর অনুরোধ করা। সুইচ অফ থাকলে চলে না; রেট না বসালে দাম "ঠিক করা নেই" দেখায়। ভিডিও এখনো সত্যিকারের বানানো হয় না — শুধু অনুরোধ জমা হয়।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: image-to-video provider adapter, price-then-request (S25, CN-039; Blueprint C8.1, C8.2; registry v282 `studio.video`, off, rate 0; migration: none — `VideoJob`/`StudioJobStatus` already in the full S00 schema): `@extas/adapters` gets a `video` kind (`AI_PROVIDER`) with a `mockVideoProvider` adapter (honest preview only — no footage is generated, matching the S23 PR 439/440 precedent) and a pure `estimateFromRate` costing function; `@extas/creative-studio` adds `video.ts` (`requestVideoJob`/`estimateVideoJob`, idempotent by request, `SOURCE_INVALID` when the product has no live photo, `OFF` while the switch is off); Marketing › Studio › Videos (`/admin/marketing/studio/videos`, Lumen pattern): pick a product/shape/length, price it (cost shown or an honest "not set" when the owner's per-second rate is still 0), then request it — the job sits as `DRAFT` ("waiting to run"); permission `marketing.studio.read`; hidden by `stages.closedShown.S25` with the rest of the tab; admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/marketing/studio-videos.md`. Running the job (queue/execute/retry) is PR 483; best-of-2 and review/approval are PR 484.
  - GitHub pull request #133, 11 Nov

## PR 483

**Image-to-video engine — part 2 (V1 C8.6 item 3)**

**বাংলায়:** চাওয়া ক্লিপ এখন "সারিতে দিন" আর "চালান" চেপে সত্যিকারের ভিডিও ইঞ্জিনে পাঠানো যায়; ব্যর্থ হলে সর্বোচ্চ ৩ বার "আবার চেষ্টা করুন"। আসল প্রোভাইডার এখনো নেই, তাই ফলাফল সৎ একটা প্রিভিউ (প্রোডাক্টের নিজের ছবি)।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: image-to-video engine — part 2, job orchestration (S25, CN-039; Blueprint C8.2; no registry change, no migration): `@extas/creative-studio`'s `video.ts` gains `queueVideoJob` (`DRAFT` → `QUEUED`), `runVideoJob` (`QUEUED` → `PROCESSING`, calls the provider's `createClip` once, lands on `REVIEW_REQUIRED` on success or `FAILED` on a provider refusal — never throws past a refusal, the job's own status and the audit log carry the outcome) and `retryVideoJob` (`FAILED` → `QUEUED` with one more `attempt`, `CAP_REACHED` past `MAX_ATTEMPTS` — a technical bound of 3, the same "no more automatic tries" shape PR 309's spend cap uses for money, here for attempts); every move off its proper state is `WRONG_STATE`. Marketing › Studio › Videos: each job row gets its own next-move button — "Queue it" on a waiting clip, "Run it" on a queued one, "Retry" (with its attempt count) on a failed one up to the cap — each move re-reads the page. No real video provider is connected yet, so a run still lands on the mock's honest preview (the source still itself, `practice: true`); review/approve from `REVIEW_REQUIRED` and best-of-2 are PR 484.
  - GitHub pull request #135, 11 Nov
- **What it does:** Image-to-video engine — part 2 (V1 C8.6 item 3) (derived)
- **Filed under:** not itemised in the register; the register lists this PR by its stage range only. The title comes from [Blueprint Appendix A](../BLUEPRINT.md#appendix-a--every-pr-1653) (marked *derived*); the scope is the stage's blueprint section.
- **What was built** (from the Build status row):
  - Code and files: `@extas/creative-studio`, `video.ts`
  - Names in the code: `queueVideoJob`, `DRAFT`, `QUEUED`, `runVideoJob`, `PROCESSING`, `createClip`, `REVIEW_REQUIRED`, `FAILED`, `retryVideoJob`, `attempt`, `CAP_REACHED`, `MAX_ATTEMPTS`, `WRONG_STATE`, `practice: true`
- **Owning agent:** Gyani

## PR 489

**Campaign overlay system — page-level and time-bound (V1 C8.6 item 9)**

**বাংলায়:** ক্যাম্পেইন ওভারলে: পণ্যের কার্ড আর পাতায় সময়-বাঁধা একটা লেবেল (কর্নার রিবন, স্ট্রিপ, ব্যাজ, কাটা-দামের ফ্ল্যাগ), ছবিতে বসে না, দাম বদলায় না; চালু-বন্ধ আপনার হাতে। স্টেজ শেষ না হওয়া পর্যন্ত মেনুতে দেখা যায় না।

**Details**

- **Status:** Merged · 2026-11-11
  - Build status row: campaign overlay system — page-level and time-bound (S25 reopened, CN-039; Blueprint C8.3 layer a, C8.6 item 9; built independently of PR 482–488's image-to-video engine): `packages/creative-studio` (`overlay.ts`) — `CampaignOverlay` CRUD (4 templates: corner ribbon, bottom strip, struck-price flag, badge; bilingual words + accent colour; reach = every product / named products / a category, by their own slugs; an optional start/end window; `isOverlayActive`, `overlayReaches`, `activeOverlayFor` pick the one, most-specific, overlay a product shows); Marketing › Studio › Campaign overlays (`/admin/marketing/studio/overlay`, Lumen pattern): list, add, enable/disable (off as shipped), archive/restore; permissions `marketing.studio.read` / `.write`; storefront wiring — read fresh on every page, never cached, never touching a price (CLAUDE.md rule 6): `ShopCard.overlay` (every card surface through `toCards`: home, category, search, wishlist, flash sale) and `PdpModel.overlay` (the product page), drawn as a small corner chip or a bottom strip over the picture only, never covering the existing sale badge or heart (AUTO ADJUST); hidden from the menu, sitemap, smoke and device-gate lists by `stages.closedShown.S25` until the whole stage is finished; admin guide `docs/admin-guide/pages/marketing/studio-overlay.md`.
